evidence.title: American Tax Funding
evidence.text: American Tax Funding (ATF) is a private company based in Jupiter, Florida that engages in the purchasing and servicing of delinquent municipal real estate tax lien sales.

evidence.title: American Tax Funding
evidence.text: Originally formed in 1997 as Transamerica Municipal Finance (TMF), a division of Transamerica Corporation.

evidence.title: American Tax Funding
evidence.text: In August 2000 the founders completed a form of a management buyout of TMF, creating ATF.

evidence.title: American Tax Funding
evidence.text: ATF currently buys and services real estate tax liens in over 14 states and has provided over $1 billion in relief to local governments.

evidence.title: American Tax Funding
evidence.text: Many ATF tax liens are secured by either Wells Fargo Foot Hill or the Harris Nesbitt Corporation.

evidence.title: American Tax Funding
evidence.text: The process of privatizing the municipal tax foreclosures process and outsourcing to out of state third party, for-profit, private companies has drawn criticism from housing advocates who argue that a for-profit tax foreclosure process leads to more foreclosures, displacement and vacancy.

evidence.title: American Tax Funding
evidence.text: The other argument is that third party purchases of tax liens enables local governments to pay for essential services such as salaries for teachers, health care, police officers and firefighters.

evidence.title: American Tax Funding
evidence.text: To date, no study has shown that the sale of tax liens to third parties leads to any increase in foreclosure activity.

evidence.title: American Tax Funding
evidence.text: In fact, the sale of liens to third party purchasers often extends redemption periods and allows flexible repayment agreements for delinquent tax payers.

evidence.title: TurboTax
evidence.text: TurboTax is an American tax preparation software package developed by Michael A. Chipman of Chipsoft in the mid-1980s.

evidence.title: TurboTax
evidence.text: Intuit acquired Chipsoft, based in San Diego, in 1993.

evidence.title: TurboTax
evidence.text: Chipsoft, now known as Intuit Consumer Tax Group, is still based in San Diego, having moved into a new office complex in 2007.

evidence.title: TurboTax
evidence.text: Intuit Corporation is headquartered in Mountain View, California.

evidence.title: Free File Alliance
evidence.text: The Free File Alliance is a group of tax preparation companies that have partnered with the Internal Revenue Service to provide free electronic tax filing services to U.S tax payers meeting certain guidelines.

evidence.title: Free File Alliance
evidence.text: The Free File Alliance claims that the program benefits American taxpayers by providing services that would cost the IRS money to provide if online tax filing were administered directly by the IRS.

evidence.title: Free File Alliance
evidence.text: The IRS stipulates filers must have an adjusted gross income (AGI) of $62,000 or less for tax year 2015, but participating companies have their own requirements and restrictions.

evidence.title: TaxAct
evidence.text: TaxAct is an American tax preparation software package.

evidence.title: TaxAct
evidence.text: It is a member of the Free File Alliance, a free federal tax preparation and electronic filing program for eligible individual taxpayers developed through a partnership between the IRS and a group of private sector tax software companies.

evidence.title: Liberty Tax Service
evidence.text: Liberty Tax Service is an American company specializing in the preparation of tax returns for individuals and small businesses.

evidence.title: Liberty Tax Service
evidence.text: It is the third largest tax preparation franchise in the United States.

evidence.title: Liberty Tax Service
evidence.text: The company began in Canada in 1997 when John Hewitt, co-founder of Jackson Hewitt, acquired a Canadian tax franchisor, U&R Tax Depot.

evidence.title: Liberty Tax Service
evidence.text: In 1998, the company became Liberty Tax Service and opened five offices in the United States.

evidence.title: Liberty Tax Service
evidence.text: Liberty Tax Service is the primary subsidiary of Liberty Tax, Inc., a NASDAQ-traded company.

evidence.title: H&R Block
evidence.text: H&R Block is an American tax preparation company in North America, Australia, and India.

evidence.title: H&R Block
evidence.text: The Kansas City-based company also offers payroll, and business consulting services.

evidence.title: Nicholas Peroff
evidence.text: Nicholas C. Peroff (born May 19, 1944) is an American political scientist, public administrator and professor in Native American studies and Complexity Theory at the Henry W. Bloch School of Management at the University of Missouri-Kansas City, he formerly held teaching positions in Taiwan, South Korea and South Africa.
